extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, and journalists seeking country-level data on participation in international environmental agreements and military expenditure (percent of GDP)
extracted.subtask_description: A country-by-country listing of participation (party/signed-but-not-ratified) in international environmental agreements followed by a dataset of military expenditures as percent of GDP for many countries (circa early 2000s). Intended as reference data rather than evaluative guidance.
